reason: The cited code evaluates an agent-supplied JavaScript expression via Playwright page/locator.evaluate and brings the returned result back into the tool handler. Because this is browser-page JavaScript, not host-side arbitrary code execution, HOSTEXEC is not supported. The evaluated code can read and return data from the current page/element context, which may include non-public logged-in page data, so SECRET is supported. Arbitrary page JavaScript can also initiate browser requests or otherwise send agent-supplied data to chosen web destinations, so SINK is supported. Since page/element content and page state can be attacker-controlled and returned as the evaluation result, UNTRUSTED is supported.
